title: Hawaiian Huli Huli Chicken
steps: Blend the ketchup, soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, sriracha, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger into a smooth liquid paste.
Marinade the chicken for a minimum of 2 hours, but ideally overnight for 24 hours.
Grill over high to medium-high heat.
Grill to an internal temperature of 165°F, flipping as needed to prevent burning.
Let the chicken rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing into strips against the grain and serving.
headnote: This chicken is traditionally grilled over Hawaiian kiawe wood fire.  Texas Mesquite is the closest substitute.  Hickory is also a suitable flavor profile.
